placements.title: Calibration moves from applied to independently verified
placements.frame: Has this instrument's calibration been checked against an external reference standard, and does that verification hold across its full operating range?
placements.why: All three expressions converge on one recurring subject: an instrument's calibration state and whether it has been independently verified against a reference standard. src-1 states the calibration is set, src-2 supplies the verification act and its scope (full observing band, checked against June reference plates), and src-3 recasts both as a logged instrument record. This is a subject future calibration envelopes (other instruments, later reference cycles, re-verification) will keep feeding — not a one-time fact — so it clears the narrative grain test rather than being folded as evidence under something else. No existing structure or strata was supplied for this repo (both empty), so nothing could be reused; this mint stands alone with no forced parent since no hub or strata category yet exists that plausibly holds it.
